headline: Ghana Revenue Authority Projects GH¢2.5B From Real-Time Cross-Border VAT
summary: The Ghana Revenue Authority expects to collect more than GH¢2.5 billion in its first year following the full implementation of a cross-border real-time VAT system starting in January.
why: Ghana is implementing aggressive digital tax compliance measures to meet fiscal revenue targets agreed under international economic recovery programs.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Digital VAT collection boosts central government fiscal revenue by GH¢2.5B in 2027.
